secrets.name: TMDB_API_KEY
secrets.description: TMDB (The Movie Database) API key from https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api. Accepts the v3 API Key (32-char) or v4 Read Access Token (JWT starting with eyJ). Required for movie/TV content to load.
